fields.name: demo_placements
fields.description: Ordered list of target positions, in [y, x], on which the goal-named cube (the colour named in the goal instruction) was released during the DEMONSTRATION, in the order the releases happened. A release is a frame where the fingers go from ~46% open to ~100% open while that cube was 'held in the gripper' just before; the entry is the position of the target closest to the cube's resting spot right after that release, taken from a demo frame where all four targets are visible (e.g. the last demo frame). Do NOT include the demo's final release near the image centre (cube left around [82, 127], no target there), do not include the cube's starting spot, do not include button presses, and do not include a release that is onto the same target the cube was just lifted from if no target lies under the cube. Written at step #1 (the only step that shows the demonstration) and copied unchanged at every later step. Empty list only if no demonstration was shown. e.g. [[116, 163], [75, 163]]

fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: The single target position, in [y, x], that the goal instruction's ordinal picks out of demo_placements: 'first' = entry 1, 'second' = entry 2, 'third' = entry 3, 'fourth' = entry 4. Written at step #1 from the demonstration and copied unchanged afterwards. unknown before the demonstration has been seen. e.g. [116, 163]
